stops.stop: Fifth Avenue, Pittsburgh: Berkman at the office door
stops.date_confidence: attested, and corroborated by a contemporary Los Angeles Herald report of 24 July 1892. The account that Frick finished the day's work before letting a surgeon in is stated as fact in the corpus text of Andrew Carnegie's file and is widely repeated; no contemporaneous medical record was located. The related tradition that he refused anesthesia during the extraction of the bullets is likewise unverified and is not asserted here
